name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-leaf-drifted
note: The Witchwarden's moss, not the nirnroot's leaf: the gradient's first stop is another title's.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-gradient-turned
note: The words drawn haze into leaf - 'Nirnroot' pale, 'Sage' dark.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-edge-dropped
note: No black edge: the haze end lost over snow and a day sky.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-one-colour-leaf
note: The button's and the glyph's colour the leaf - near the Spire Champion's jade.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-glyph-colour-drifted
note: The glyph in the haze, not its title's glow: the grant's two halves drift apart.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-mark-the-wikimaids
note: The classic face's mark the WikiMaid's ears - two glyphs one mark.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-stroked
note: The sprig drawn as an outline - its filled leaves a scribble at 13 px.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-button-paint
note: The smoke's button in the Witchwarden's paint.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-title-word
note: Half the owner's word over his head.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-aura-word
note: The aura's word not as named.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-heart-deep
note: The bulb's heart dark - a nirnroot that does not glow.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-heart-out-of-bulb
note: The heart down the stem, out of the bulb.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-leaf-dropped
note: The right broad leaf gone - a sprig with one leaf at its foot.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-outline-crossing
note: The upper left leaf's edge swung through the broad leaf below it: the outline crosses itself, and the aura's even-odd fill cuts a hole where they overlap.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-list-key
note: The title read off a list the config does not have: nobody holds it.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-glyph-word
note: The WikiMaid's glyph beside his name.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-aura-grant
note: The Lilac Warren granted for the Sage's Smoke.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-handle
note: Another account's name - Blob-Marley holds nothing.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-title-not-in-vocabulary
note: The title the service signs is a word the relay refuses.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-glyph-not-in-vocabulary
note: The glyph the service signs is a word the relay refuses - every token of his refused whole.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-aura-not-in-vocabulary
note: The aura the service signs is a word the relay refuses.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-relay-unmoved
note: The vocabulary changed under a relay version already named.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-the-kind
note: Drawn as Witchfire.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-added-not-covered
note: Drawn added: the smoke a glow, never a cover; the nirnroots washed out over a bright floor.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-rune-ring-out
note: The runes out past the fire's ring - not about the feet.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-orbit-off-whole
note: The nirnroots' orbit off whole over the clock: they jump at the wrap.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-puff-life-off-whole
note: A puff's life off whole over the clock: the smoke pops at the wrap.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-glow-drifted
note: The runes' glow the leaf's - the aura drifted off its title's paint.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-rise-slow-first
note: The smoke creeps off the ground and races at the top - not billowing up.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-growth-dropped
note: Every puff its first size - no billowing out.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-drift-dropped
note: The smoke climbs straight up its column, never out from the body.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-flight-never-moves
note: Every flight of a puff off the same place - a fountain, not a cloud.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-wrap-broken
note: The flight not wrapped with the clock: every puff jumps elsewhere at the wrap.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-orbit-radius
note: The nirnroots off their orbit - an ellipse, not a ring round the waist.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-spacing
old: const a = (k / SAGE_ROOTS) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI * 2 * SAGE_HZ.orbit * t;
new: const a = (k / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI * 2 * SAGE_HZ.orbit * t;
note: Two nirnroots on top of each other.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-bob-dropped
note: The nirnroots on rails, not afloat.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-all-up-at-once
note: Every nirnroot up at once as it kindles.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-nearest-first
old: rows.sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0]);   // farthest first
new: rows.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);   // farthest first
note: Nearest first: a far puff laid over a near nirnroot.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-near-fade-dropped
old: rows.push([d, p.x, p.y, p.z, p.size, 0, p.age, k1 * near * near * (3 - 2 * near), p.seed]);
new: rows.push([d, p.x, p.y, p.z, p.size, 0, p.age, k1, p.seed]);
note: The wearer's own first person smoked out.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-puff-kindle-ignored
old: rows.push([d, p.x, p.y, p.z, p.size, 0, p.age, k1 * near * near * (3 - 2 * near), p.seed]);
new: rows.push([d, p.x, p.y, p.z, p.size, 0, p.age, near * near * (3 - 2 * near), p.seed]);
note: The smoke whole before the aura has kindled.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-puff-added
note: A puff added - a glow, never smoke.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-puff-cover-ignored
note: The law's cover dropped: the smoke in the wearer's eyes, and before it kindles.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-puff-lit-from-below
note: The smoke lit from below.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-veins-dropped
old: col = mix(col, SG_DEEP, clamp(0.5 - sageVeinD(g) / px, 0.0, 1.0));
note: The aura's nirnroots without their veins - not the badge's own.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-heart-dropped
old: col = mix(col, SG_HAZE, clamp(0.5 - sageBudD(g) / px, 0.0, 1.0));
note: The aura's nirnroots without the bulb's glowing heart.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-halo-covering
note: A nirnroot's glow covering - a dark card round every nirnroot.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-runes-dropped
note: No runes round the feet.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-band-dropped
note: The runes' band unlined.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-shade-added
note: The smoke's shade at the feet added - a green smear, not a shade.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-shade-kindle-ignored
note: The shade at the feet before the aura kindles.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-runes-kindle-ignored
note: The runes lit before the aura kindles.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-wall-added
note: The low smoke added - a glow round the boots.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-wall-rim-dropped
note: The low smoke as thick across the boots as along the strip - a grey band over the feet.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-wall-kindle-ignored
note: The low smoke whole before the aura kindles.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-puff-not-facing
old: w = at + r * o.x + cross(e, r) * o.y;
note: A puff a flat card along one axis - a sliver from the side.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-root-turn-ignored
note: The nirnroots never sway.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-root-leaning
old: w = at + vec3(-toEye.y, 0.0, toEye.x) * o.x + vec3(0.0, o.y, 0.0);
new: w = at + vec3(-toEye.y, 0.0, toEye.x) * o.x + vec3(toEye.x, 1.0, toEye.y) * o.y;
note: A nirnroot leaning toward the eye.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-cards-not-handed
note: The cards never handed: every puff and nirnroot at the feet, sized nothing.

name: NIRNROOT-SAGE-seed-ignored
note: Every wearer's smoke in step.
